comments.4-1-1/Paired Edges:
video timestamp
nice, because it's a 4-1-1 4 slicer
good alg: pair on the frontslash line → paws
bad alg: pair on the backslash line → paws
comments.3-3/Paired Edges:
video timestamp
nice, because 3-3 is always good
good alg: pair on the frontslash line, 2 slices → scallop/kite
bad alg: pair on the backslash line, 2 slices → scallop/kite
comments.3-1-2/Paired Edges:
video timestamp
evil, because 3-x-x is usually bad
good alg: 2 slices → shield/square
bad alg: → 5-1/L
comments.3-2-1/Paired Edges:
video timestamp
evil, because 3-x-x is usually bad
good alg: 2 slices → shield/square
bad alg: → 5-1/L
comments.Scallop/Shield:
video timestamp
nice, because scallops have their shells, which are kinda like shields, so this CS makes sense
good alg: hide a pair on the frontslash line, 2 slices → scallops
bad alg: hide a pair on the backslash line, 2 slices → scallops
comments.Scallop/Left Fist:
video timestamp
follow, because a fist can eat the scallop (fist dominates)
good alg: 2 slices 2-gen to scallop/kite
bad alg: 2 slices 3-gen to scallop/kite
comments.Scallop/Right Fist:
video timestamp
follow, because a fist can eat the scallop (fist dominates)
good alg: 2 slices 2-gen to scallop/kite
bad alg: 2 slices 3-gen to scallop/kite
comments.Shield/Left Fist:
video timestamp
evil, because a medieval weapon (shield) is not enough to fight an angry person nowadays, you are dead
good alg: 2 slices 2-gen → paws
bad alg: 2 slices 3-gen → paws
comments.Shield/Right Fist:
video timestamp

good alg: 2 slices 2-gen → paws
bad alg: 2 slices 3-gen → paws
comments.6/Paired Edges:
video timestamp
evil, because both shape are symmetrical but are not sliceable at the symmetry axis (the concentrated power of the 6 met its match in the concentrated poewr of the pair)
good alg: pair on the frontslash line → scallops
bad alg: pair on the backslash line → scallops
